name: Liu Extension of Bresenham
definition: An efficient extension of Bresenham's algorithm that determines the intersection point of the line with two walls and compares the error against a specific threshold to visit both diagonal neighbors if necessary, adjusting to integer arithmetic thereafter.
summary: The Liu Extension of Bresenham is a 3D voxel traversal algorithm that detects diagonal neighbors by comparing error against a geometric threshold, unlike standard Bresenham which uses simple integer accumulation.
